_comment: Behaviour profiles for the three study conditions. C1 and C2 use IDENTICAL cue form and differ only in WHO is targeted (adaptivity). C2 and C3 use the IDENTICAL participation model and differ only in HOW the cue is expressed (cultural adaptation). Keep it that way so the contrasts stay clean. C3 values are Phase-1 hypotheses: replace them with the co-designed behaviour set.

c1.label: C1 Non-adaptive
c1.description: Gaze follows the speaker; attention and invitations cycle evenly through seats (round robin).

en: Would you like to add something?

c2.label: C2 Adaptive-conventional
c2.description: Same cue form as C1, but gaze, head and invitations are directed at the least active learner (Gillet et al. 2021).

en: Would you like to add something?

c3.label: C3 Adaptive-Nuru
c3.description: Same participation model as C2, expressed through the culturally adapted cue set: group first, then neighbouring pair, short individual gaze with a soft nod, bilingual prompt, long wait with gaze returned to the group, gentle release, acknowledging nod.

en: Would you like to add something?
